welcome_title: How can I help you on your computer today?
welcome_subtitle: Choose a quick command below or type your question to get started.
suggestion_pc: What can you do on my PC?
suggestion_docs: How to read documents and PDFs
voice_hint: Speak clearly into the microphone (5 seconds)
voice_activated: Microphone activated. Speak after the beep. Press F2 to cancel.
voice_error: Could not hear you. Please try again with F2.
spotlight_placeholder: Ask a quick question to Cromak Bridge...
opt_mode_high_contrast: Bridge Vox High Contrast (For Low Vision)
opt_agent_mode: Agent Mode (Auto-Coder) - Allows AI to read and edit files
opt_fullscreen: Always launch Bridge in fullscreen (F11 to toggle)
opt_tray: Minimize to system tray on close (Tray)
api_keys_local_notice: API keys are saved locally on your device.
placeholder_custom_prompt: Define global behavior rules for the AI responses...
workspace_desc: Bridge automatically detects real Windows folders (even on other drives like D: or E:). Smart file search operates strictly within these 6 folders for maximum speed and security.
email_config_desc: Configure to allow the AI to send and read emails quietly on your account.
shortcuts_click_hint: Click on a field and press the desired key.
about_description: Cromak Bridge is the ubiquitous AI engine of the Matrix Core suite. Designed for advanced workflow integration, it operates at the structural layer of Windows, providing autonomous script execution (Auto-Coder) and multimodal iteration through the world's most advanced APIs.
about_warning: Notice: Agent Mode command execution interacts directly with the host system. Please review recommended security settings.
about_a11y_text: Special thanks to Gustavo Torniero (Journalist and Digital Accessibility Consultant) for voluntary technical guidance in practical screen-reader (NVDA) navigation testing on Bridge Vox 1.3.5.
dialog_confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete this chat?
vox_welcome_speech: Accessibility system started. Press space and ask your question.
vox_response_received: Response received. Press SPACE to speak again.
vox_did_not_understand: Could not hear you. Can you repeat?
vox_connection_error: A connection error occurred. Check your API key in settings.
a11y_no_response_yet: No AI response to read yet.
a11y_provider_changed: Provider changed to {provider}. Enter your key below.
a11y_msg_sent_thinking: Message sent. Please wait, AI is thinking...
a11y_api_key_required: Please enter the API key for the selected provider ({provider}).
dialog_exit_msg: Cromak Bridge Vox Assistant will be closed. Do you really want to exit the program? Press Enter to exit or Esc to cancel.
dialog_exit_cancelled: Exit cancelled. Continuing in the assistant.
connection_diag_desc: Successfully connected to the Internet and active AI engine.
connection_diag_hint: Click or press Enter to verify
connection_offline_desc: Your computer has no Internet access. Check your Wi-Fi or network cable.
connection_api_required_desc: No API key configured for the current engine. Click to configure.
tab_nav_cycle: Use Tab to cycle forward and Shift + Tab to cycle backward across the entire interface.
